message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges. Primary charge likely 危险驾驶 (dangerous driving). The companion charges list: 单位受贿, 妨害公务, 私分国有资产, 窝藏、包庇. We need to include each ONLY if facts support it.

Facts: Li was drunk driving, caught. Also previously convicted of 过失损坏军事通信罪 (negligent damage to military communications) and was in probation period, then reoffended new crime. The new crime is drunk driving. Also he voluntarily turned himself in after police call. No mention of unit bribery, obstruction of public duty, misappropriation of state assets, or harboring/abetting. However, there is a possible "妨害公务" (obstructing public duty) because he was caught by police while drunk driving. But does that constitute obstruction? Usually, "妨害公务" is interfering with police performance of duty, e.g., resisting arrest. Here he was just caught, no resistance. So not.

Thus only primary charge: 危险驾驶. Also maybe "妨害公务" if the act of drunk driving interferes with police duty? But not indicated. So answer: [罪名]危险驾驶<eoa>
